name: No-cascade days: at 11:35 go with price vs the open
why: The day's net flow so far is the best available guess of who is still positioning. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_daily_trade.md).

checks.when: !rollwin && abs(at(9,50)-open) <= 0.25*atr && abs(at(10,30)-open) <= 0.3*atr && abs(at(11,0)-open) <= 0.3*atr && abs(px-open) <= 0.3*atr && px != open
